arxiv-2302-06055.title: Computation Offloading for Uncertain Marine Tasks by Cooperation of UAVs and Vessels
arxiv-2302-06055.creator: Jiahao You † , Ziye Jia † , Chao Dong † , Lijun He ∗ , Yilu Cao † , and Qihui Wu †
arxiv-2302-06055.description: Abstract With the continuous increment of maritime applications, the development of marine networks for data offloading becomes necessary. However, the limited maritime network resources are very difficult to satisfy real-time demands. Besides, how to effectively handle multiple compute-intensive tasks becomes another intractable issue.

arxiv-2405-10386.title: Proto-neutron stars with quark cores
arxiv-2405-10386.creator: Adamu Issifu, Débora P. Menezes, Zeinab Rezaei, Tobias Frederico
arxiv-2405-10386.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Adamu Issifu, Débora P. Menezes, Zeinab Rezaei, Tobias Frederico. This work investigates the evolution of proto-neutron stars (PNSs) from birth as neutrino-rich objects to maturity as cold-catalyzed neutrino-poor objects with nucleonic and non-nucleonic degrees of freedom. The focus is on the star’s core where the nucleons, hyperons, and the Δ \Delta -isobars are expected to dissolve into a “soup" of deconfined quarks, at higher baryon densities, to establish a possible hadron-quark phase transition.

arxiv-2412-09094.title: Filter-then-Generate: Large Language Models with Structure-Text Adapter for Knowledge Graph Completion
arxiv-2412-09094.creator: Ben Liu 1 † \dagger, Jihai Zhang 2, Fangquan Lin 2, Cheng Yang 2, Min Peng 1
arxiv-2412-09094.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) present massive inherent knowledge and superior semantic comprehension capability, which have revolutionized various tasks in natural language processing. Despite their success, a critical gap remains in enabling LLMs to perform knowledge graph completion (KGC). Empirical evidence suggests that LLMs consistently perform worse than conventional KGC approaches, even through sophisticated prompt design or tailored instruction-tuning.

arxiv-2501-05169.title: A New Value for Cooperative Games on Intersection-Closed Systems Journal: Mathematical Social Sciences
arxiv-2501-05169.creator: Martin Černý
arxiv-2501-05169.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Martin Černý. We introduce a new allocation rule, the uniform-dividend value (UD-value), for cooperative games whose characteristic function is incomplete. The UD-value assigns payoffs by distributing the total surplus of each family of indistinguishable coalitions uniformly among them. Our primary focus is on set systems that are intersection-closed , for which we show the UD-value is uniquely determined and can be interpreted as the expected Shapley value over all positive (i.e., nonnegative-surplus) extensions of the incomplete game.

arxiv-2508-16322.title: Filtrations and asymptotic geometry of non-Archimedean norms on section rings.
arxiv-2508-16322.creator: Rémi Reboulet
arxiv-2508-16322.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rémi Reboulet. This article is concerned with the metric study of a construction of Gérardin of the action of the boundary at infinity of the space of norms on a non-Archimedean vector space, and its generalisation to graded algebras.

arxiv-2511-20783.title: A derivative-free trust-region approach for Low Order-Value Optimization problems This study was financed in part by the Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior – Brasil (CAPES) – Finance Code 001
arxiv-2511-20783.creator: A. E. Schwertner, F. N. C. Sobral
arxiv-2511-20783.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by A. E. Schwertner, F. N. C. Sobral. The Low Order-Value Optimization (LOVO) problem involves minimizing the minimum among a finite number of function values within a feasible set. LOVO has several practical applications such as robust parameter estimation, protein alignment, portfolio optimization, among others.

arxiv-2512-06487.title: Deciphering transmission spectra by exploring the solar paradigm
arxiv-2512-06487.creator: N.-E. Nèmec, Ò. Porqueras-León, I. Ribas, and A. I. Shapiro
arxiv-2512-06487.description: Abstract Context. Transmission spectroscopy allows measuring the wavelength dependence of the transit signal of an exoplanet, thus enabling probing its atmospheric composition. However, the transmission spectrum also carries information of the host star, generally referred to as ’contamination’. Stellar activity leads to an apparent change in the stellar radius, thus, directly impacting the transit depth.

arxiv-2601-16931.title: The scaling relations of galaxies with different morphology: comparison among WINGS, MANGA and Illustris data samples.
arxiv-2601-16931.creator: Mauro D’Onofrio, Francesco Brevi, Cesare Chiosi, Paola Marziani
arxiv-2601-16931.description: Abstract We present a panoramic view of several scaling relations (ScRs) of galaxies of different morphology. The ScRs are obtained from the data of two large surveys (WINGS and MANGA). We analyze the distribution (parameterized by the percent over the total) of galaxies in each region of the diagnostic planes that are set up by means of suitable physical quantities.

pmc-10647204.title: Diffuse Cardiac Uptake Misdiagnosed as Cardiac Amyloidosis in Bone Scan
pmc-10647204.creator: Yeongjoo Lee, Jaehyuk Jang, Sae Jung Na, Consolato M Sergi
pmc-10647204.description: In this presented case, a 77-year-old woman with an implanted prosthesis and ongoing knee pain underwent a bone scan using 99mTc-hydroxydiphosphonate (HDP) in suspicion for bone infection. An incidental finding from this scan revealed diffuse cardiac uptake, necessitating further diagnostic procedures to exclude the possibility of cardiac amyloidosis.

pmc-11472575.title: Clinical and molecular cytogenetic findings of cat eye syndrome and a 2-year-old patient with congenital aural atresia and hearing loss
pmc-11472575.creator: Liang Xu, Xia Cheng, Lemin Tang, Shengping Min, Jiatao Wu, Hongwei Zhu, Yaping Liao
pmc-11472575.description: BackgroundCat eye syndrome (CES) is a rare congenital disease frequently caused by a partial tetrasomy of the proximal long (q) arm of chromosome 22, due to a small supernumerary marker chromosome (sSMC). CES patients show remarkable phenotypic variability. Despite the progress of molecular cytogenetic technology, the cause of phenotypic variability and the genotype–phenotype correlations remain unknown.

pmc-12548912.title: Stn1 supports Mec1 function in protecting stalled replication forks from degradation
pmc-12548912.creator: Erika Casari, Flavio Corallo, Luca Edoardo Milani, Renata Tisi, Maria Pia Longhese, Ashok Bhagwat, Ashok Bhagwat, Ashok Bhagwat
pmc-12548912.description: Replication stress threatens genome integrity by exposing replication forks to nucleolytic degradation. In both yeast and humans, the checkpoint kinases Mec1 and Rad53 limit deleterious single-stranded DNA (ssDNA), yet the protective mechanisms remain incompletely defined. Here, we identify a role for the CST subunit Stn1 in cooperating with Mec1 to restrain ssDNA formation under nucleotide depletion.

pmc-12606403.description: Climate warming is changing tundra vegetation in the Arctic, with implications for plant litter properties. Warming may thus modify bacterial and fungal communities and their nitrogen (N) cycling capacity in the litter layer, which in turn can affect plant N availability.
